answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 60714 Country: India Title: Lailatul Qadr may fall even out after Ramadan Question: I heard from a Muslim scholar that Lailatul Qadr date is not fixed either in 27 of Ramadan of 25. Not only in odd number of last 10 day of Ramadan "even Lailatul Qadr can fall after or before Ramadan ie any one day of year". May you please provide me any hadith or Prophet (pbuh) companion’s narration regarding this or scholar's quote if any? Answer ID: 60714 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 956/971/H=10/1436) Fazail Aamal part one contains a chapter ’Fazail Ramadan’ where this subject has been introduced well. Read out it four or five times thoroughly then if you want some explanation then write it to us. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
